detail:
Full summary: Added needs-human tag band and URL linkification to the Triage dashboard (client-side only, API unchanged): pinned band + badge for needs-human tagged rows, detail_preview rendered in rows, http(s) links clickable in rows and detail panels. Spec §8 amended; 7 new tests; 1408 green.
Decisions: Chose a needs-human TAG convention with client-side band/badge over a mechanism field or new bucket — 'what needs a human' is per-project policy (§9 litmus test); tags are the named-field partition channel §4.2 assigns to presentation; promotion into the mechanism waits on field evidence per the twining_handoff precedent; Chose to linkify only http(s) URLs, DOM-constructed with stopPropagation anchors, and explicitly NOT file paths — a served page cannot open local files; a raw-file route is new server surface needing path-traversal design, deferred as future work in spec §8
Findings: Triage rows now render detail_preview (previously in the payload but unrendered) — doc links in need details are visible and clickable directly in the queue
